title: Merry Christmas, 2 dollars

specs.Decoration: digital printing, microprinting, transparent capsule containing a silver 24-carat gold-plated filigree insert

descriptionPlain: Description Spirit of Christmas captured in fine silver Colorful artwork full of symbols Fairytale and magical design Perfect gift – not only for children In this enchanting time of year, we surround ourselves with beautiful items that highlight the unique atmosphere of the holidays. A symbolic first star is placed inside a delicate capsule, while the reverse side of the coin features a magical train, driven by Santa Claus himself, delivering gifts to children. Delight your loved ones and make this Christmas unforgettable. Give them a piece of magic that will stay with them for years.
